    para_Enrollment     IN NUMBER,
    para_Institution_id IN VARCHAR2,
    para_Height_feet    IN NUMBER,
    para_Street_address IN VARCHAR2
) IS
...

Return the complete stored procedure and nothing else.

whether the building delete matches on building_id or building_code
